label: Card Fan
description: A group as cards: the people (photo or initials), the templates, the sources. layout 'fan' (default): cards enter one by one from below into a 3D arc, the fan turns slowly while the voice names the group, one card can come forward (focus). layout 'ring': the cards stand on a circle and the whole ring TURNS at a constant rate across the beat -- cards pass in front and behind, the near card biggest and sharpest, the far ones smaller and dimmer -- and can collapse away one by one at the end (the launch-film 'the right creators' beat). White cards with a floor shadow on a light world, charcoal on dark. Three to six cards in a fan, up to ten in a ring; one line of type names the group. Position and size it with the component's box; it sizes itself to it.

cards.label: Cards in order: [{label, sublabel, src: a REAL /assets/... image or omit for an initials avatar, initials, color}] (3-6 in a fan, up to 10 in a ring)

label.label: Card title (a name, a template, a source)

src.label: Image (a real asset URL); omit for an initials avatar

initials.label: Avatar initials when no image (default: from the label)

at.label: When the first card enters (scene seconds; default 0.4)

layout.label: fan (default: a spread arc) | ring (a turning carousel around a vertical axis)

spread.label: Degrees between neighbouring cards (default 13; 0 for a straight row)

turn.label: fan: degrees of slow yaw while it holds (default 7). ring: degrees the ring turns over the whole beat (default 180; negative turns the other way)

speed.label: ring only: degrees per second, instead of turn (e.g. 50)

start.label: ring only: the ring's starting angle in degrees (default 0: card 1 at the front)

radius.label: ring only: circle radius as a fraction of the box's short side (default: sized so the cards fit the circle)

tilt.label: ring only: camera pitch in degrees, seeing the ring from slightly above (default 10)

focus.label: Index of the card that comes forward (omit for none)

focus_at.label: When the focus card comes forward (scene seconds; default: after the last card lands)

collapse_at.label: ring only: scene seconds when the cards shrink away one by one (omit to hold)

theme.label: light (white cards, default) | dark (charcoal cards for a dark ground)

hold.label: Seconds before the fan exits (0/omit = stays)

scale.label: Size multiplier for the whole prop
